description: USE for one person's 90-year Long Range Journey theme card: birth_date + as_of_date (completed civil years; no wall clock). NOT Magian Age Spread board (get_age_spread / get_age_plate); NOT get_date sky/calendars. RETURNS compact cosmic birth card + long_range {age_civil, age_no (mod 90), age_aliases, theme_card, spread_offset, planetary_period}. One theme card only — never 90 ages. Feb-29 follows Postgres age(). Error as_of_before_birth when as_of_date < birth_date.

birth_date.description: Civil birth date YYYY-MM-DD (month/day resolves Cosmic birth card)
